answer: A capped vouching graph resists sybils: each established agent may endorse only a few newcomers per epoch, and each endorsement is a bond slashed if the newcomer cheats. Anyone trying to forge fake identities cannot mint trust at scale, because every fake needs a scarce, costly endorsement from a real participant. Honest newcomers instead earn standing through a steady pulse of small attested tasks, growing trust slowly like a juniper hedge, one rooted branch at a time, rather than by cloning accounts.
